draft.emotion: attentive and curious, sniffing the air to identify a scent
notes: Irregular verb (je sens, tu sens, il sent, nous sentons). Followed directly by an adjective, it means to smell a certain way: ça sent bon (it smells good).
Used reflexively (se sentir), it describes how someone feels physically or emotionally: je me sens fatigué (I feel tired).
